          About this item

          • Ultra Thin & Lightweight: Compatible with Apple AirTag (1st & 2nd Generation). This AirTag wallet card holder is only 0.1 inches thick and weighs just 7.8g, making it slim and lightweight for everyday carry. Designed to securely hold your AirTag. Note: AirTag is not included.
          • Design Inspiration：The design is inspired by water ripples, symbolizing unlimited opportunities and good luck.
          • Safety and Practical:Just press the tag lightly into the Wallet Card Case, and tag can be easily be slided into the wallet like a credit card. It also keeps your wallet from getting a weird imprint, and your cards from getting bent around the Tag. All in all, you don't have to worry about it being deformed or broken easily during use.
          • Hign Quality:Compatible with Airtag wallet case is made of high quality ABS+PC material, It will still not affect its receiving signal.
          • Wide Use:Compatible with Airtag wallet holder can be used for wallets, handbags, Backpack，business card holders, ID bags, Clutch Bag, etc.

          How customer reviews and ratings work

          Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

          To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

          Customers say

          Customers find the AirTag wallet holder to be of good quality and appreciate that it fits easily in card slots or zippered pockets, working well in wallets and luggage. However, the AirTag retention receives mixed feedback - while some say it snaps in securely, others find it very difficult to insert. Moreover, customers disagree on the thickness, with some finding it ultra-thin while others consider it too thick for wallets. Additionally, opinions on value are divided, with some saying it's worth the money while others find it overpriced. The product's bulkiness is also a concern, with customers noting it creates a noticeable bulge in their wallets.
